rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the reported 3AA grade, but it overstates certainty from a single focal plane and claims TE cohesion and zona thinning more confidently than is clearly visible in this image.
Integrates age, prior failed cycle, BMI, endometrium, and sperm data reasonably well with embryo quality, though AMH is unavailable and some discussion of male factor is speculative.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, especially around age-related aneuploidy moderating morphology-based prognosis, though some probability statements are somewhat broad and not tightly sourced.

Mostly aligned on SET and recognizing age-related aneuploidy, but recommending ERA after a single failed cycle and strongly recommending PGT-A are more aggressive than guideline-based routine practice; advising not to freeze for PGT-A is also somewhat oversimplified.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET and luteal support review, but some recommendations lack nuance and prioritization for this specific history.
